title: Missing viewport declaration
user_impact: On mobile devices the text appears below any readable size; zooming in forces horizontal scrolling. Desktop browsers are not affected.

checks.source: Best practice (no WCAG criterion): without a viewport declaration mobile browsers lay out at desktop width and scale the page down; CSS Device Adaptation
checks.applicability: Every HTML document: there is no document the check does not apply to.
checks.expectation:
A best-practice finding at the root element when the document has no meta
name=viewport, neither in the markup nor inserted by script. Any viewport
declaration, whatever its content, satisfies this id. No not-applicable case
exists: every HTML document is in scope.
